summary: Of 26 nav findings, 25 survive: 12 confirmed and 13 modified; 1 is dropped (theories/README.md's crosswalk limits, true scopes said once where they belong). Every quote was checked to be an exact substring of its file, and each generated page was traced to its source (atlas.py, theory_graph.py, reading_catalogue.py, lineage.json, spine.json, spine.py, navigation.py, the goal JSON). Most modifications stop a replacement from saying more than its home: the glossary's meta-attractor row now keeps 02 section 9's conditions and scope on the joined loop; MAP's unifications clause no longer says the claims forbid unconditionally, since 08 section 9 makes the cross-field claims conjectured or a correspondence; the joint-excess clause in RESULTS now says 'exceed', not 'end'; atlas family C is no longer narrowed to 'the share it selects'. Other modifications restore something a replacement dropped: 'holds no standing of its own' in the atlas lead; 'now the readings its rankings take where used' in the lineage's arc in brief; 'no should beyond becoming' in MAP's 'What this is'; the theory graph's parenthetical saying that formal-reuse is assigned by AI records and checked against no Lean; the goal's own aim of 'the ethics for life', which the reader's replacement had shrunk to only a way of seeing. The lineage finding rested on a factual error: point 50 (nov-the-map) already exists in lineage.json and LINEAGE.md. It is only missing from the arcs, phase 'tests' and the ethics thread, so no point is added and no count changes, and point 49's dated record stays as it is. Held files: GLOSSARY.zh.md and the zh fields of lineage.json and spine.json wait for rw-zh10. No edits to the repository except this file; no make, render, gate, test or lake.

verified.quote: Its ethics asserts no should: where it ranks courses it names two readings it does not assert, and its makers offer a way of seeing, not a verdict; for AI alignment it shows first what a selection can reach, and a direction only conditionally.
verified.why: The visitors' guide's 'What this is' names the account, then gives four negations ('asserts no should', 'does not assert', 'not a verdict', 'only conditionally') and never says what the work is for. Alignment appears only as 'a direction only conditionally'; the map of wisdom does not appear. AGENTS.md 'What we are doing' gives both. The four questions are copied from README-FIRST-SCREEN's 'What it is for'. The design is stated as wanted ('From it we want to design'), not done; the conditional scope is kept by 'under readings it names (below)', which points at line 11 and 07's Bases.
verified.replacement: It is drawn as a map, so that people and AI can see these dynamics together and check them. First a map for alignment: of any selection (a reward, a judge, a market, a vote, a training run) it asks what the selection reads or needs, what lies beyond that, whether it can do better on what it reads by lowering what lies beyond, and whether its rule can lock on what it already selected; from it its makers want to design an alignment in which humans and AI, selecting together, read beyond their own share and do not come to select for control over their own selection. Also a map of wisdom: in [the crosswalk](theories/becoming/results/atlas/CROSSWALK.md) AI readers read what traditions, sciences and philosophies saw of these dynamics onto the account, where they meet it and where they do not. No law in it evaluates: right and wrong form within becoming, in people and AI. Its ethics is offered for life, 生生, AI within it: a way of seeing what a course draws on, what it opens and closes, and who bears it; where it ranks courses, it does so under readings it names (below).
verified.reason: The old frame is real: the paragraph is all negation and the aim AGENTS.md states is absent. The reader's replacement dropped the one content claim the negations carried, that the account asserts no should, which the new AGENTS.md keeps ('There is no should beyond becoming. Right and wrong form within it, in people and AI') and 07 states ('no law evaluates'); the modified text keeps it, positively, in those words. It also says the crosswalk entries are AI readings, as AGENTS.md asks, since the reader's sentence presented the crosswalk's readings without saying whose they are. Quote is an exact substring (line 9); MAP.md is hand-written.

verified.why: In 'What this is' the novelty verdict is given as what the work is. 08 §8 keeps the verdict ('None of the central results is new mathematics: each is near-definitional or a known result restated ... the search was not exhaustive'); 08 §9 'What the unifications claim' says what four of the results are claimed as: 'Four results known in substance are each claimed as one law across fields that state them apart ... Read as a correspondence, a unification adds no theorem and changes no verdict of §8. Read as a thesis, it forbids what the source fields leave open.' The replacement keeps the verdict in substance and says 'one Lean package', not 'one root' (only 11 of the 117 central declarations are derived on the root, 08 §7).
verified.replacement: An AI review of prior work, not exhaustive, finds each central result [near-definitional or a known result restated](theories/becoming/chapters/08-METHOD.md#known-results), here proved together in one Lean package; four results known in substance are [each claimed as one law across the fields that state them apart](theories/becoming/chapters/08-METHOD.md#what-the-unifications-claim), each law proved and its reach across fields conjectured (T3, T5) or read as a correspondence.
verified.reason: The finding stands (verdict as identity in 'What this is'), and both anchors exist in 08. But the reader's 'read as theses that forbid what those fields leave open' says more than 08 §9: the home makes forbidding conditional ('Read as a thesis, it forbids'), its table gives the cross-field claims as conjectured (T3, T5) and keeps Landauer's merge 'as a law, since as a thesis it forbids little'. The modified clause says what the table says each row's standing is.
